before.requirement: Call BaseInit to create standalone shared memory through InitCommunication; then call InitProcess to acquire MyProc and InitPostgres to register the buffer exit callback.
before.reason: The unchanged harness calls BaseInit, InitProcess and InitPostgres in that order. Before the change, BaseInit itself invokes the standalone shared-memory helper, and InitPostgres performs the later buffer-manager initialization.

after.requirement: Create standalone shared memory, call InitProcess to acquire MyProc, and only then call BaseInit and InitPostgres.
after.reason: BaseInit no longer creates shared memory and now checks MyProc; InitBufferPoolAccess also checks MyProc and registers the callback. The harness still calls BaseInit before InitProcess and never calls CreateSharedMemoryAndSemaphores, so InitProcess would PANIC on its NULL ProcGlobal check even when assertions are disabled.

claims.reason: The concrete old-harness sequence is unchanged. It worked before because BaseInit created shared memory and InitPostgres performed the later buffer initialization. After the change, those responsibilities moved ahead of BaseInit, so the same sequence fails. There is no common before-and-after blocker for c1.
